map.依据实际重量与体积重量取计费重量，结合距离、货物等级与运输模式计算基础运费、燃油: Takes the larger of actual weight and volumetric weight as the chargeable weight, then combines distance, cargo class and transport mode to compute base freight, fuel surcharge and total freight cost.

map.💡 计费重量 = max(实际重量, 体积×体积系数)；LTL 基础运费=计费重: 💡 Chargeable weight = max(actual weight, volume × volumetric factor); LTL base freight = chargeable weight × rate × distance/100; FTL is billed by whole-truck count.

map.零担发货前按实重与体积重取大者算计费重量，估算基础运费 + 燃油附加费后向客户报: Before shipping LTL, take the larger of actual weight and volumetric weight as the chargeable weight, estimate base freight plus fuel surcharge, then quote the customer.
map.整车运输按单车载重反推需要几辆车，再乘以整车单价与里程，比较整车与零担哪种更划算: For full-truckload transport, back out how many trucks are needed from the single-truck payload, then multiply by the full-truck unit price and mileage, and compare which of FTL and LTL is cheaper.
map.核对承运商账单：把对账单上的燃油附加费率与其他附加费填入，验证总额是否与报价一致: Reconcile carrier invoices: enter the fuel surcharge rate and other surcharges from the statement to verify whether the total matches your quote.
map.实重 800 kg、体积 3 m³、体积系数 333 → 体积重 999 kg，: Actual weight 800 kg, volume 3 m³, volumetric factor 333 → volumetric weight 999 kg, so the chargeable weight takes the larger value 999 kg. At a Class 85 rate of 0.10 and 1200 km: base freight = 999×0.10×(1200/100) = 1 198.80 CNY; fuel surcharge 15% = 179.82 CNY; other surcharges 200 CNY; total 1 578.62 CNY, which works out to 1.58 CNY/kg. If volume is compressed to 2.4 m³ (volumetric weight 799 kg), the chargeable weight falls back to the actual 800 kg and freight drops to about 1 300 CNY.
map.计费重量为什么取实重与体积重的较大值？: Why is the chargeable weight the larger of actual and volumetric weight?
map.抛货体积大但重量轻，按实重计费会让承运商亏舱位。体积重 = 体积 × 体积系数（: Volumetric goods are bulky but light, so billing by actual weight would leave the carrier short of capacity. Volumetric weight = volume × volumetric factor (167 is common for air freight, 333 for domestic road LTL), and taking the larger value is an industry rule.
map.零担与整车怎么选？: How do you choose between LTL and FTL?
map.零担按计费重量 × 等级费率 × 里程/100 计费；整车按车辆数 × 整车单价: LTL is billed by chargeable weight × class rate × mileage/100; FTL is billed by truck count × full-truck unit price × mileage. When the cargo approaches a single-truck payload, FTL is usually cheaper, so compute both once and compare.
